name: Ivanhoe Electric (IE)
teaser: At spot copper the Santa Cruz study is worth $3.5 billion, but at $9.66 the stock already prices long-term copper of about $5.79 a pound, above the banks' long-term decks, before the $1.426 billion mine is financed. My Base is $7.38, so the call is Reduce, with no buy zone.
llms: Pre-revenue US copper developer whose value rests on one asset, the 100% owned Santa Cruz underground SX-EW cathode project in Arizona (2026 study: initial capex $1.426 billion, first cathode 2029, 24-year life). Valued on risked NAV at a 10% real discount rate on an estimated copper deck of $6.00/lb in 2029 to 2030 fading to $5.20/lb by 2033, cross-checked with 5.5x mid-cycle EBITDA discounted to today. At $9.66 the price implies long-term copper of about $5.79/lb, above the bank long-term decks, while about $1.67 billion of pre-production needs face $197.1 million of net cash and an uncommitted EXIM loan of up to $1.1 billion. Bear $0.93, Base $7.38, Bull $11.35. Verdict REDUCE (HOLD is a reasonable alternative, triggered by a firm EXIM commitment of at least $1.0 billion at today's capex or long-term copper expectations of $5.41 or more), required margin of safety 80%, no maximum buy price issued.
